data.one_liner: Flutter bindings for OpenCV4 using dart:ffi.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart/Flutter access to OpenCV4 core and contrib modules via FFI. Enables image, video, and computer‑vision processing on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.
use_when: You need high‑performance native computer‑vision algorithms
You require OpenCV modules like DNN, feature detection, or video I/O
Your app runs on supported desktop or mobile platforms
avoid_when: You target web only (no native assets)
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution with smaller binary size
You want to avoid potential FFmpeg licensing issues
strengths: Supports both core and many contrib modules
weaknesses: Requires native build steps and CMake configuration
Large binary size and possible licensing concerns with FFmpeg
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart SDK >=3.10 (Flutter 3.38), enables native‑assets hooks, may need to install CMake and configure custom cmake generator, ensure platform SDKs are present, watch out for FFmpeg licensing when using video modules

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure‑Dart image manipulation library, no native build required, suitable for simple image tasks and web
